answer.reason: The adapter maps the three vendor grades one-for-one onto the three ScanVerdict members (SF_OK→usable, SF_LOW_RES→rescan-needed, SF_MARGIN_UNCLEAR→unreadable), and there is no domain spec or glossary that names these distinctions. The only core branch (case-order.ts) checks just usable versus everything else, so the three-way split comes from the vendor rather than from anything the domain needs.
